question: Does the fixed projectable HMT U(1) symmetry/universal physical-metric construction plus GR/PPN recovery impose an exact action-level relation that uniquely reduces the surviving matter-interface family, independently of RTK response and soft-s data?

independent_sources.role: universal HMT physical-ADM matter interface and full PPN analysis
earlier projectable U(1)-invariant physical-metric prescription and solar-system constraint

decision_rule: EXACT_SELECTOR requires an explicit action-level identity from the audited HMT symmetry/physical-metric construction that fixes every scalar-response-relevant surviving interface parameter before any RTK response comparison. CONTINUOUS_FAMILY applies when the sources explicitly retain arbitrary interface constants and/or only observationally bounded regions while GR PPN recovery is achievable without a unique action-level relation. INCOMPLETE applies if the required source statements cannot be locked. Phenomenological choice of one allowed point is not a selector.
required_guards: distinguish U(1) invariance from uniqueness of coupling coefficients
distinguish unit normalization freedom from fixing a1,a2
do not treat GR/PPN recoverability as a unique action-level identity
do not select a representative point from an allowed region
